name: 3C | Jack Kraken | 8th
description:
GENETICS: Northern Lights #5 x Shiva Skunk
AROMA: Herbal, Piney, Sour
EFFECT: Cerebral, Creative, Euphoric, Well-Rounded, Relaxing
TERPENES:
Terpinolene: energizing, uplifting and calming
Farnesene: muscle relaxer, calming and sedative effects, anti-inflammatory, anti-fungal, and antibacterial properties
β-Caryophyllene: stress, anxiety and pain-relieving terpene may also promote sleep as a result of those relaxing, anxiolytic and analgesic properties

DESCRIPTION: An undeniable classic in cannabis cultivars, Jack Kraken is an original cut of the legacy sativa strain Jack Herer. The nostalgic aroma of pine trees, sour lemon rinds and apricots, soak the monster sized, green buds. It's energetic and uplifting, yet subtle calming effects make it a perfect companion for a wake and bake session or to cruise through the afternoon. 

CONSPIRACY: It might be obvious at this point, that we just love The Kraken. The Kraken is a legendary squid-like sea monster of giant size (40-50 feet in length). It was first described by an anonymous Norwegian author in the 13th century work called the Konungs skuggsjá. According to legend, the Kraken terrorizes sailors off the coasts of Norway and Greenland.
Note: THC% may vary batch to batch.
